description: One injected in-order four-zero-octet TCP segment; retain every kernel ACK/window/time difference. No application read or socket-buffer-content claim.

assumptions: Pinned packetdrill generates zero-filled incoming TCP payloads; arbitrary byte injection is unsupported by this finite adapter.
IR fixed MSS4/window16 are model parameters; Linux MSS and receive window are not forced to equal them.
No outbound application data, PSH, FIN, loss or kernel-internal state observation.
